Counsel,

Please see our revised draft reflecting your requested revisions: Settlement Amount of $425,000 payable within three business days, dismissal following receipt of cleared funds, confidentiality carve-outs, mutual non-disparagement, no retaliation/interference, each side to bear its own fees and costs, and Court retention of jurisdiction to enforce.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the amount of Four Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Dollars ($425,000) (the “Settlement Amount”) within three (3) business days after the Effective Date by wire transfer or other mutually agreed immediately available funds. Payment shall be deemed made only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of cleared funds.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims that were asserted or could have been asserted in the action through the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall file a dismissal of the action with prejudice promptly after receipt of cleared funds, and no dismissal shall be required before such receipt.
edits.name: Release and Dismissal

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement strictly confidential, except that disclosure may be made: (a) as required by law, court order, subpoena, or other legal obligation; (b) as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; (c) to the parties’ respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, tax advisors, and other professional advisors who have a need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the terms; and (d) to immediate family members and business principals, as applicable, provided they are informed of the confidential nature of the terms.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or responsibility by any party.
edits.name: No Admission

edits.text: 5. MUTUAL NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree that they shall not make, publish, or communicate to any person or entity any false or disparaging statement concerning the other party, the action, or the settlement, except as required by law or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Mutual Non-Disparagement

edits.text: 6. NO RETALIATION OR INTERFERENCE. The parties shall not retaliate against, harass, intimidate, or improperly interfere with the other party, including with respect to any business, employment, contractual, or prospective economic relationship, arising out of or relating to the action or this settlement.
edits.name: No Retaliation or Interference

edits.text: 7. FEES AND COSTS. Each party shall bear its own attorneys’ fees, costs, and expenses incurred in connection with the action, the negotiation of this Agreement, and the performance of this Agreement, except as otherwise expressly provided in a written agreement signed by the parties.
edits.name: Fees and Costs

edits.text: 8. RETENTION OF JURISDICTION. The Court shall retain jurisdiction to enforce the terms of this Agreement and any dismissal may so provide, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
edits.name: Retention of Jurisdiction
